newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka mulls Feb diesel tender after Jan award.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka mulls Feb diesel tender after Jan award.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) has awarded a end January diesel and jet fuel buy tender to Swiss trader Glencore and is likely to issue a tender for February cargoes, a CPC source said on Monday.

Glencore was awarded the tender to supply 185,000 barrels of 1.0 percent sulphur gas oil and 40,000 barrels of jet fuel at a premium of $1.50 a barrel and $1.60 a barrel respectively, over spot Singapore quotes.
Both cargoes were offered on a cost-and-freight basis to Colombo for delivery between January 23-27.
The source said CPC will decide later Monday on its decision to issue another tender for the purchase of diesel and jet fuel for February arrival.

Glencore was also awarded the tender to supply 185,000 barrels of 1.0 percent sulphur gas oil and 85,000 barrels of 85 to 88-octane leaded gasoline at a premium of $2.10 a barrel and $3.28 a barrel respectively, over spot Singapore quotes.
Both cargoes were offered on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) to Colombo for delivery on January 29-30.
Traders said the scheduled 45-day shutdown of the Sapugaskanda 60,000 barrels-per-day refinery from mid-January had led to increased diesel and jet fuel purchases.
